from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485207/attempts/aebe2cf00e3243528294ba8447492ab6/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=programs/'task-e73264fa.py'
source='''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for row in out:\n        first = row[0]\n        split = 0\n        while split < len(row) and row[split] == first:\n            split += 1\n        if 0 < split < len(row):\n            row[split:] = [1] * (len(row) - split)\n    return out\n'''
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(path),'exec'),globals())
d1_in=[[4]*20,[4]*20,[8]*20]+[[4]*20 for _ in range(6)]+[[8]*16+[4]*4]+[[4]*20 for _ in range(4)]
d1_out=[r[:] for r in d1_in]; d1_out[9][16:]=[1]*4
d2_in=[[5]*9,[5]*9,[6]*4+[5]*5]+[[5]*9 for _ in range(6)]+[[6]*9,[5]*9]
d2_out=[r[:] for r in d2_in]; d2_out[2][4:]=[1]*5
print('demo1 matches',transform(d1_in)==d1_out,'demo2 matches',transform(d2_in)==d2_out)
